summary: <cite index="2-5,2-7">U.S. markets rebounded Monday as Anthropic's IPO filing and easing oil prices lifted sentiment ahead of a packed week</cite>. <cite index="13-1,13-2">The Federal Reserve meets October 27–28, with a rate decision expected Wednesday at 2:00 PM ET</cite>. <cite index="16-10,16-11">Markets price a roughly 90% probability the Fed will keep rates unchanged at 3.75%–4.00% after September's 25-basis-point hike</cite>. <cite index="29-3,32-2">Mega-cap tech earnings dominate the calendar, with Microsoft and Alphabet reporting Wednesday after the close, followed by Intel and Amazon Thursday</cite>. <cite index="19-3,19-5">In crypto, Bitcoin fell below the crucial $80,000 mark over the weekend, pressured by concerns about AI infrastructure spending and risk-off sentiment</cite>. <cite index="22-7,22-9">Bitcoin dropped as low as $79,300 on the same day AI stocks tanked, and is trading near its 30-day low</cite>. <cite index="27-6,27-7">Ethereum traded near $2,320 as $44 million in ETH liquidations, $1.18 billion in October ETF outflows, and a delayed network upgrade weighed on sentiment</cite>. <cite index="52-6,52-7">Oil sold for $115.41 per barrel (Brent), down 23 cents from yesterday but up approximately $49.50 over the past year</cite>. <cite index="2-9">Brent crude hovered near $117 in a volatile session</cite>, reflecting ongoing Middle East tensions.

signals.title: Bitcoin breaks below $80K on AI spending fears and ETF outflows
signals.desc: <cite index="21-16,21-17">U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $773.5 million on October 22–23, and Bitcoin traded near $79,947 after hitting an intraday low around $79,332</cite>, signaling further downside risk before Wednesday's Fed decision.

signals.title: Fed decision Wednesday: 90% odds of a hold at 3.75%–4.00%
signals.desc: <cite index="14-7">A hold at 3.75%–4.00% is the overwhelming consensus, so the December language will matter more than the rate itself</cite>, with inflation at 3.7% keeping December hike risk alive.

signals.title: Anthropic IPO filing sparks tech rebound; chips rally 3%
signals.desc: <cite index="2-5,2-7">Anthropic PBC filed for an IPO, fueling a revival in the AI trade and sending a closely watched chipmaker gauge up 3%</cite>, offering relief after last week's Meta-driven selloff.

signals.title: Ethereum faces triple headwinds: liquidations, outflows, upgrade delay
signals.desc: <cite index="27-11,27-12">CoinGlass data showed about $44 million in ETH positions liquidated over 24 hours, with roughly 74% from longs, including a single $6.97 million liquidation on Binance</cite>, compounding ETF redemption pressure.

signals.title: Oil hovers near $117 on Iran tensions, stoking inflation fears
signals.desc: <cite index="47-1,47-5">Crude oil prices reached a five-month high following reports the U.S. and Israel might plan a renewed attack on Iran, with Brent rising 3.1% to $116.72</cite>, threatening Fed tightening and weighing on risk assets.

verdict: Markets await Fed decision and mega-cap tech earnings in a week that will determine whether AI trade fears or growth optimism prevail.
